reason: Initial N4 and first N6-engine records show phase-step failures near the fold and some Nelder-Mead iteration limits despite agreeing candidate locations. Preserve the original outputs and criteria. This supplement evaluates denser loops and directly checks stationarity using eigenvalue derivatives.
loop_selection: Both radii and both nodes at the parent finest-fold D minus 0.01; enclosing ellipse at D=40. Keep the parent's overlap, exterior gap, loop-gap and phase-step thresholds. Require both new meshes to pass and have the same integer indices.
minimum_selection: All three candidate minimizer outputs at each of the three post-event D stations in the parent run, including failed attempts. These are candidate checks, not independent global searches.
gradient: Exact eigenvalue first derivative for the affine family: v_upper^T H_i v_upper minus v_lower^T H_i v_lower; the gap is strictly positive at the candidate minima.
claims_limit: Numerical phase sampling and local stationarity/curvature only. No root-absence certificate, full braid acceptance, or change to original failed optimizer results.
